name: ArenaGaugeBand
description: One stretch of a gauge's scale and what a value inside it means. A band runs from its `from` to the next band's `from`, and the last one to the gauge's `max`, so a list of bands cuts the scale without a gap and without an overlap. The word is required because a status colour never ships alone: the label is what the centre reading, the table and a screen reader say.

from.description: Where the band starts. Inclusive: a value equal to `from` is in this band and not in the one below.

tone.description: What a value in the band means, drawn as the arc's colour while the value is in it and as a tint of the band's stretch of the ring.

label.description: Names the band, under the centre reading while the value is in it and as the row header of the band's range in the table. Required and guarded, because a colour with no word is a status a reader who cannot tell the hues apart never receives.
